raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

SGLang can't serve PEFT LoRA adapters that target the Gated DeltaNet (GDN) layers of Qwen3.5-family hybrid models (for example `Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B` and `nvidia/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4`). There are three separate problems:

1. **rsLoRA scaling is ignored.** Adapters trained with `use_rslora=True` are applied at `alpha/r` instead of `alpha/sqrt(r)`. At rank 64 that makes them 8× too weak, and served outputs look close to the base model's.
2. **GDN projections aren't loaded.** The target allowlist omits PEFT's GDN names (`in_proj_qkv`, `in_proj_z`, `in_proj_a`, `in_proj_b`). PEFT's combined `in_proj_qkv`/`in_proj_z` tensors aren't packed into the runtime `in_proj_qkvz`, and there is no packed target for the gating projections.
3. **Shared-expert-only adapters wrap the routed experts.** An adapter that targets only the dense shared expert still has the routed-expert bank wrapped for LoRA and gets expert LoRA buffers, because both paths use `gate/up/down_proj` names. That allocates unused memory. It also rejects MoE runner backends without routed LoRA support (for example native NVFP4 `flashinfer_cutlass`), even though the adapter never touches the routed experts.

## Modifications

Three commits, each reviewable on its own:

- **`fix(lora): honor rank-stabilized adapter scaling`.** Use `alpha/sqrt(r)` when the PEFT config sets `use_rslora`; ordinary LoRA is unchanged.
- **`fix(lora): load PEFT GDN projections for Qwen3.5 hybrids`.**
  - Normalize and pack combined QKV/Z into `in_proj_qkvz`. PEFT's shared `lora_A` is repeated per Q/K/V rank block.
  - Pack B/A into a new `in_proj_ba` target, in the base layer's order.
  - Add the target names, stacked multipliers and dimensions.
  - Add a synthetic public-model reproducer, `test/manual/lora/repro_qwen35_peft_dense_adapters.py`.
- **`fix(lora): leave untargeted routed experts on the base backend`.**
  - Infer from the initial adapters' tensors whether routed-expert LoRA is needed. When it isn't, leave the routed `FusedMoE` modules unwrapped and skip their LoRA buffers.
  - Starting with no initial adapters keeps the previous behaviour, so dynamic MoE loading still works.
  - Loading routed-expert tensors later into a dense-only pool raises a clear error instead of failing silently.

This adds no quantization kernel and no routed-expert LoRA implementation. The shared expert stays on its dense LoRA path (`--disable-shared-experts-fusion`).

## Accuracy Tests

- **Packing:** unit tests check that packed GDN products equal the original PEFT products, for both QKV/Z and B/A.
- **Synthetic public adapter**, rank 8 and 620 factors, generated from the public config only by the reproducer:
  - On `nvidia/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4` (revision `1355db6a`) with TP=2, all three public prompts change their next-token logprobs against the base.
  - Both TP ranks match all 380 normalized live factors exactly to their expected tensor slices.
  - Dynamic load and unload work.
- **Trained adapter:** a rank-64 rsLoRA adapter trained with PEFT on synthetic data, on attention, GDN and the shared expert. We compared fact recall on 445 held-out questions per adapter, served against local PEFT inference:
  - bf16 (`Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B`, TP=2): within ±0.007 for all three adapters tested.
  - NVFP4 with `flashinfer_cutlass` (TP=1 and TP=2, bf16 or fp8_e4m3 KV): 0.007 to 0.025 below local, consistent with quantization.
  - Without these patches, the same adapters can't be loaded, or they recall at base-model level.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No kernel changes. For dense-only adapters, routed experts now skip the LoRA wrapper and buffers, so they run on the unmodified base MoE backend. We haven't benchmarked speed.

## Reproduction

```bash
python test/manual/lora/repro_qwen35_peft_dense_adapters.py \
  --model-path nvidia/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 --base-model nvidia/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 \
  --revision 1355db6a052410cfd62085d94b58866fd0f2c3c5 --output-dir /tmp/qwen-dense-lora

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 python -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path nvidia/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 --revision 1355db6a052410cfd62085d94b58866fd0f2c3c5 \
  --served-model-name qwen --tp-size 2 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_cutlass \
  --enable-lora --lora-backend triton --lora-strict-loading --lora-paths dense-example=/tmp/qwen-dense-lora \
  --max-lora-rank 8 --max-loras-per-batch 2 --max-loaded-loras 2 --disable-shared-experts-fusion \
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30000

python test/manual/lora/repro_qwen35_peft_dense_adapters.py --output-dir /tmp/qwen-dense-lora \
  --check-only --already-loaded --check-url http://127.0.0.1:30000 --served-model qwen --adapter-name dense-example
```

The adapter is selected as `model=qwen:dense-example`. The random adapter shows the adapter is applied; it says nothing about task quality.

Validated on SM120 (RTX PRO 6000) with torch 2.14.1+cu130, transformers 5.19.0, FlashInfer 0.7.2 and sglang-kernel 0.4.10. GPU runs used the Python radix-tree backend, because the dev container lacked the source checkout's Rust extension.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). (isort 7.0.0 and Ruff 0.15.1 on all changed files.)
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). (rsLoRA scaling, GDN packing, manager wrapping, memory pool: 62 targeted tests pass.)
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Accuracy above; no kernel or speed change.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+"""Generate a synthetic PEFT adapter for public Qwen3.5-family hybrid MoE models.
+
+No training data or model weights are needed to generate the adapter. It covers
+attention, GDN projections and the dense shared expert, with no routed experts.
+Start a server with this adapter in --lora-paths, then use --check-url and
+--already-loaded to compare next-token logprobs with the base model.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import urllib.request
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+from safetensors.torch import save_file
+from transformers import AutoConfig
+
+TARGETS = [
+    "q_proj",
+    "k_proj",
+    "v_proj",
+    "o_proj",
+    "in_proj_qkv",
+    "in_proj_z",
+    "in_proj_a",
+    "in_proj_b",
+    "out_proj",
+    "gate_proj",
+    "up_proj",
+    "down_proj",
+]
+
+
+def post(url, route, payload):
+    request = urllib.request.Request(
+        url + route, json.dumps(payload).encode(), {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
+    )
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=120) as response:
+        return json.load(response)
+
+
+def generate(args):
+    config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(args.model_path, revision=args.revision)
+    config = config.get_text_config()
+    hidden = config.hidden_size
+    head = config.head_dim
+    key = config.linear_num_key_heads * config.linear_key_head_dim
+    value = config.linear_num_value_heads * config.linear_value_head_dim
+    shared = config.shared_expert_intermediate_size
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(42)
+    tensors = {}
+    for layer, kind in enumerate(config.layer_types):
+        if kind == "linear_attention":
+            dimensions = {
+                "linear_attn.in_proj_qkv": (hidden, 2 * key + value),
+                "linear_attn.in_proj_z": (hidden, value),
+                "linear_attn.in_proj_b": (hidden, config.linear_num_value_heads),
+                "linear_attn.in_proj_a": (hidden, config.linear_num_value_heads),
+                "linear_attn.out_proj": (value, hidden),
+            }
+        else:
+            dimensions = {
+                "self_attn.q_proj": (
+                    hidden,
+                    config.num_attention_heads
+                    * head
+                    * (2 if config.attn_output_gate else 1),
+                ),
+                "self_attn.k_proj": (hidden, config.num_key_value_heads * head),
+                "self_attn.v_proj": (hidden, config.num_key_value_heads * head),
+                "self_attn.o_proj": (config.num_attention_heads * head, hidden),
+            }
+        dimensions.update(
+            {
+                "mlp.shared_expert.gate_proj": (hidden, shared),
+                "mlp.shared_expert.up_proj": (hidden, shared),
+                "mlp.shared_expert.down_proj": (shared, hidden),
+            }
+        )
+        for module, (inputs, outputs) in dimensions.items():
+            prefix = f"base_model.model.model.layers.{layer}.{module}"
+            tensors[prefix + ".lora_A.weight"] = (
+                torch.randn(args.rank, inputs, generator=generator) * 0.02
+            )
+            tensors[prefix + ".lora_B.weight"] = (
+                torch.randn(outputs, args.rank, generator=generator) * 0.002
+            )
+    out = Path(args.output_dir)
+    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    save_file(tensors, str(out / "adapter_model.safetensors"))
+    (out / "adapter_config.json").write_text(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "base_model_name_or_path": args.base_model,
+                "peft_type": "LORA",
+                "task_type": "CAUSAL_LM",
+                "r": args.rank,
+                "lora_alpha": 8,
+                "use_rslora": True,
+                "lora_dropout": 0.0,
+                "bias": "none",
+                "inference_mode": True,
+                "target_modules": TARGETS,
+            },
+            indent=2,
+        )
+    )
+    return len(tensors)
+
+
+def check(args):
+    loaded = False
+    if not args.already_loaded:
+        result = post(
+            args.check_url,
+            "/load_lora_adapter",
+            {
+                "lora_name": args.adapter_name,
+                "lora_path": args.server_adapter_path or args.output_dir,
+            },
+        )
+        if not result.get("success", False):
+            raise RuntimeError(result)
+        loaded = True
+    try:
+        rows = []
+        for prompt in [
+            "What is 2 + 2?",
+            "Name a primary color.",
+            "Complete: The quick brown fox",
+        ]:
+            outputs = []
+            for model in [
+                args.served_model,
+                args.served_model + ":" + args.adapter_name,
+            ]:
+                result = post(
+                    args.check_url,
+                    "/v1/chat/completions",
+                    {
+                        "model": model,
+                        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
+                        "max_tokens": 1,
+                        "temperature": 0,
+                        "logprobs": True,
+                        "chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": False},
+                    },
+                )
+                outputs.append(result["choices"][0])
+            base, adapted = outputs
+            base_lp = base["logprobs"]["content"][0]
+            adapted_lp = adapted["logprobs"]["content"][0]
+            changed = (
+                base_lp["token"] != adapted_lp["token"]
+                or abs(base_lp["logprob"] - adapted_lp["logprob"]) > 1e-6
+            )
+            rows.append(
+                {
+                    "prompt": prompt,
+                    "base": base_lp,
+                    "adapter": adapted_lp,
+                    "changed": changed,
+                }
+            )
+        if not all(row["changed"] for row in rows):
+            raise AssertionError(rows)
+        return {"passed": True, "prompts": rows}
+    finally:
+        if loaded:
+            result = post(
+                args.check_url, "/unload_lora_adapter", {"lora_name": args.adapter_name}
+            )
+            if not result.get("success", False):
+                raise RuntimeError(result)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--model-path", default="Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B")
+    parser.add_argument("--base-model", default="Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--revision", default="995ad96eacd98c81ed38be0c5b274b04031597b0"
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--rank", type=int, default=8)
+    parser.add_argument("--check-url")
+    parser.add_argument("--served-model", default="qwen")
+    parser.add_argument("--adapter-name", default="dense-example")
+    parser.add_argument("--server-adapter-path")
+    parser.add_argument("--already-loaded", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--check-only", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    result = {}
+    if not args.check_only:
+        result["generated_factors"] = generate(args)
+    if args.check_url:
+        result["check"] = check(args)
+    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""CPU regression tests for PEFT GDN packing."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.lora.lora import LoRAAdapter
+from sglang.srt.lora.lora_config import LoRAConfig
+from sglang.srt.lora.utils import get_normalized_target_modules, get_stacked_multiply
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestQwen35PEFTLoRA(unittest.TestCase):
+    def adapter(self, rslora=False):
+        cfg = LoRAConfig.from_dict(
+            dict(
+                peft_type="LORA",
+                r=4,
+                lora_alpha=8,
+                use_rslora=rslora,
+                target_modules=["in_proj_qkv", "in_proj_z", "in_proj_a", "in_proj_b"],
+            )
+        )
+        return LoRAAdapter(
+            "test", cfg, SimpleNamespace(num_hidden_layers=1), None, None
+        )
+
+    def test_peft_gdn_packing_preserves_deltas(self):
+        torch.manual_seed(42)
+        rank, hidden = 4, 8
+        sizes = {"in_proj_qkv": 16, "in_proj_z": 8, "in_proj_b": 2, "in_proj_a": 2}
+        weights = {}
+        originals = {}
+        prefix = "base_model.model.model.layers.0.linear_attn."
+        for module, out_dim in sizes.items():
+            a, b = torch.randn(rank, hidden), torch.randn(out_dim, rank)
+            originals[module] = (a, b)
+            weights[prefix + module + ".lora_A.weight"] = a
+            weights[prefix + module + ".lora_B.weight"] = b
+        adapter = self.adapter()
+        adapter.initialize_weights_from_tensors(weights)
+        packed = adapter.layers[0].weights
+        self.assertEqual(len(packed), 4)
+        x = torch.randn(3, hidden)
+        for packed_name, modules, split_sizes in (
+            ("in_proj_qkvz", ["in_proj_qkv", "in_proj_z"], [4, 4, 8, 8]),
+            ("in_proj_ba", ["in_proj_b", "in_proj_a"], [2, 2]),
+        ):
+            a = packed[prefix + packed_name + ".lora_A.weight"]
+            b = packed[prefix + packed_name + ".lora_B.weight"]
+            a_slices = a.split(rank)
+            b_slices = b.split(split_sizes)
+            result = torch.cat(
+                [x @ ai.T @ bi.T for ai, bi in zip(a_slices, b_slices)], dim=-1
+            )
+            expected = torch.cat(
+                [x @ originals[m][0].T @ originals[m][1].T for m in modules], dim=-1
+            )
+            torch.testing.assert_close(result, expected)
+            self.assertEqual(len(a_slices), get_stacked_multiply(packed_name))
+        self.assertEqual(
+            get_normalized_target_modules(sizes), {"in_proj_qkvz", "in_proj_ba"}
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""Rank-stabilized adapters must preserve the PEFT scaling rule."""
+
+import math
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from sglang.srt.lora.lora import LoRAAdapter
+from sglang.srt.lora.lora_config import LoRAConfig
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestRsLoRAScaling(unittest.TestCase):
+    def scaling(self, rank, **options):
+        config = LoRAConfig.from_dict(
+            dict(
+                peft_type="LORA",
+                r=rank,
+                lora_alpha=8,
+                target_modules=["q_proj"],
+                **options,
+            )
+        )
+        return LoRAAdapter(
+            "test", config, SimpleNamespace(num_hidden_layers=1), None, None
+        ).scaling
+
+    def test_rslora_uses_square_root_rank(self):
+        for rank in [4, 8, 64]:
+            with self.subTest(rank=rank):
+                self.assertAlmostEqual(
+                    self.scaling(rank, use_rslora=True), 8 / math.sqrt(rank)
+                )
+
+    def test_standard_lora_scaling_is_unchanged(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self.scaling(64), 0.125)
+        self.assertEqual(self.scaling(64, use_rslora=False), 0.125)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
